'''Roemalle''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#Free Years|Free Years]]. It was founded after the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]], and was established on the former territory of [[Aramaelle]]. It was later absorbed by the growing might of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]]. The lands it once held are now desolate and mountainous wilderness.

==Geography==
[[Image:Roemalle.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Roemalle was located in and around the southern part of the [[Black Hills]], with its borders established at the [[River Antaeo]] in the northeast, [[Dragonmount]] to the east, [[Caralain Grass]] to the south, and the upper reaches of the [[River Ivo]] to the west. It was bordered by [[Elsalam]] to the north, [[Tar Valon]] to the east, [[Dal Calain]] and [[Masenashar]] to the south and southwest, and [[Oburun]] to the northwest.

==History==
Very little is known of Roemalle's history beyond its name. It was conquered by [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] and made part of his empire, but its lands fell into decline and are no longer claimed by any nation.
